summary: Iteration 14 - i18n/Internationalization Testing Complete. All 6 languages (FR, EN, ES, DE, IT, PT) working correctly. Language switcher component functional with localStorage persistence. Navbar, Login, Register, Live page, and AgeGate modal all properly translated. All data-testid attributes preserved across language switches.

issues: 'Devenir créatrice' link still shows in French instead of Spanish translation - minor, not in scope for this iteration

critical_code_review_comments: i18n infrastructure properly initialized with i18next + react-i18next + LanguageDetector
6 locale files created with ~100 keys each (fr, en, es, de, it, pt)
Language detection order: localStorage > navigator > htmlTag
LanguageSwitcher component has proper data-testid attributes (lang-switcher-btn, lang-switcher-menu, lang-option-{code})
All translated components use useTranslation hook correctly
LiveDot component properly translates 'updated Xs ago' format for all languages
AgeGate modal fully translated including heading, body, buttons, and privacy note
Auth pages (Login/Register) fully translated including labels, buttons, error messages
Live page fully translated including eyebrow, title, subtitle, gender tabs, sort tabs, favorites button, empty states
context_for_next_testing_agent: i18n implementation complete for initial scope (Navbar, AuthPages, Live page, AgeGate). Other pages (Dashboard, Wallet, CreatorProfile, Messages, etc.) remain in French (fallback) - this is expected and acceptable for this iteration. Language switcher works correctly and persists selection to localStorage.
